1. This Misc. Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act has been filed for enhancement of compensation against the Award dated 08-02-2022 passed by I Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Maihar, District Satna in M.V.C. No.15/2021.
2.

entities.text: I Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Maihar, District Satna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Since, the factum of accident is not in dispute, therefore, it is suffice to mention here that deceased Dinesh Vishwakarma, aged about 35 years, lost his life in a vehicular accident which took place on 14.10.2020.

3. Challenging the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal, it is submitted by counsel for the Appellant that the accident took place on 14.10.2020 and even according to the notification issued under the Minimum Wages Act, the monthly income of an unskilled labourer was Rs.8400/-
whereas the Claims Tribunal has assessed the monthly income of the deceased as Rs.6625/- whereas his monthly income should have been Rs.8400/-.
4.
Per contra, the Counsel for the Insurance Company has supported the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6. Counsel for the appellants is correct in submitting that the notification issued under the Minimum Wages Act can be considered for fixing the notional income.

As per the notification, the monthly income of an unskilled labourer on 14.10.2020 was Rs.8400/-, therefore, the appellants are entitled for the following compensation amount :-
S.No. Head Amount 1.

Monthly Income as per Minimum Wages Rs.8,400/-
Act 2. Future Prospects @ 40% Rs. 3,360/-
3.

Monthly income + future prospects Rs.11,760/-
4.

Personal expenses @ 1/4th Rs. 2,940/-
5. Loss of monthly dependency Rs.8,820/-
6. Loss of yearly dependency Rs. 1,05,840/-
7. Multiplier @ 16 Rs.16,93,440/-
8.
Funeral Expenses Rs.15,000/-

9. Loss of Estate Rs.15,000/-
10.

11.

Consortium Rs.40,000 x 6 Rs. 2,40,000/-
12.

Total Compensation Amount Rs. 22,38,440/-
13.

Amount Awarded by Claims Tribunal Rs. 19,07,600/-
Compensation enhanced by Rs. 3,30,840/-
7.
The appeal has been valued at Rs.50,000/- and the court fees of Rs.1,250/- has been paid and accordingly the compensation is enhanced by a further sum of Rs.50,000/-.
The remaining conditions of the award shall remain the same.
8. With aforesaid modifications, the Award dated 08-02-2022 passed by I Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Maihar, District Satna in M.V.C. No.15/2021 is hereby affirmed.
